about_the_game:
Corrupted Souls – A Souls-like Descent into Betrayal and Flame
Face the truth they tried to bury… and awaken the fire they feared.

You were once a knight of the realm—silent, loyal, and forgotten. Betrayed by those you bled for, you were cast into the Monster World: a cursed land where humanity’s sins fester in monstrous form.

Surrounded by creatures born from rage and wisdom, you wander a broken world ruled by the Four Catastrophes—beings chosen by the elder monsters to protect the last fragments of freedom. Each step forward leads you deeper into forgotten tombstones, cryptic truths, and a fate far darker than exile.

Your only weapon is pain. With every wound, the cursed flame within you grows. When the “Burn” ignites, your silence becomes a scream, your blade becomes ruin, and your body sprouts the wings of vengeance.

Key Features:

  • Souls-Inspired Combat – Precise dodges, punishing parries, and deadly blade strikes. Every mistake is paid in blood.

  • The Burn System – Take damage to unleash a demonic form, igniting your sword and awakening black flame wings.

  • Stat & Spirit Customization – Level your attributes, enhance your armor’s spirit, and unlock hidden traits like poison or bleed resistance.

  • Lore-Driven Exploration – Discover the story through tombstones scattered across the world, each revealing the truth of your downfall.

  • The Four Catastrophes – Defeat the elemental protectors of Forest, Frost, Fire, and Lightning to break the seal back to the human world.

  • Steam Achievements & Cloud Saves – Track your journey, and continue your progress on any device.

  • Arabic Language Support – Full localization for Arabic-speaking players.

  • Early Access Commitment – Receive regular updates, new areas, and refined content based on player feedback.

Will you reclaim your soul… or become the very monster humanity fears?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent depictions of violence and gore, including blood, death animations, and dark themes. Players may encounter disturbing visuals such as corpses, screams, and grotesque enemy designs. Viewer discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD is recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • Additional Notes: High settings may require modern GPU. Game supports scalable quality options.
